findings.problem: ATTEMPTED/UNKNOWN suppresses resend but the existing callback requires an actually received alert; an undelivered alert has no discoverable/resend UI in this patch.
findings.minimum_revision: Explicitly distinguish actually delivered buttons from guaranteed human visibility/recovery, retain original TTL/review and no automatic CLEAN, add original-message reply reference, and do not add a second owner or scan/retry system.

findings.problem: Real DynamoDB resource callback readback uses numeric Decimal values while the in-memory fake preserves int; exact-int-only checks reject valid IDs and broad int conversion truncates bad fractions.
findings.minimum_revision: Separate input true-int caller from persisted finite integral Decimal/int, reject bool/fraction/nonfinite/string/nonpositive/self, reject invalid target before selected_action or Telegram effects, and cover real moto readback-to-callback.
